text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives telegrams of congratulations from senior officials on February 8 revolution.
- Arab League supports Iraq's demand to have $50 million of its frozen money released to enable Iraqi pilgrims perform the haj this year.
- Iraqi and Arab trades unionists fly to Sudan in a show of solidarity with Khartoum.
- China calls for the respect of Sudanese sovereignty.
- Ekeus arrives in Moscow as Russia calls for a quick end to Iraq's weapons file.
- Culture and information minister meets Russian ambassador.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
